findings.current:
*Song Il.*

Unlike the other two members of the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts, Song Il was tall and strikingly handsome.
findings.defect: 송일섬 is a newly introduced character named Song Ilseom, not the established Zhongnan elder 송일, Song Il. The draft conflates two distinct identities.
findings.rationale: The source consistently gives this escort captain’s full name as 송일섬, whereas the binding glossary’s Song Il applies only to the exact name 송일.
findings.replacement:
*Song Ilseom.*

Unlike the other two members of the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts, Song Ilseom was tall and strikingly handsome.
findings.source:
‘송일섬.’

송일섬은 용봉삼표의 다른 두 사람과는 달리 훤칠하고 잘생긴 외모의 소유자였다.

findings.current: They were the three outstanding escorts who represented the Yongbong Escort Bureau—the men known collectively as the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts.
findings.defect: The draft reduces the three men from 표두, supervisory escort captains, to ordinary escorts and loses their hierarchy within the bureau.
findings.rationale: 표두 is a ranked leadership position distinct from an ordinary 표사, or escort.
findings.replacement: They were the three outstanding escort captains who represented the Yongbong Escort Bureau—the men known collectively as the Dragon-Phoenix Three Escorts.
findings.source: 용봉표국을 대표하는 뛰어난 세 명의 표두. 이른바 용봉삼표(龍鳳三鏢)라 불리는 이들이었다.

findings.defect: The draft promotes 송 표두 to Chief Escort, but Heo Jun alone is 총표두, the Chief Escort. It also continues the mistaken rendering of 송일섬 as Song Il.
findings.rationale: 송 표두 denotes Escort Captain Song; the source reserves 총표두 for Heo Jun.
findings.replacement: *But surely Escort Captain Song Ilseom wouldn’t…*

findings.current: “No. I was hit a quarter of an hour ago.”
findings.defect: The draft changes the stated interval: 한 식경 is approximately the time required to eat a meal, conventionally about half an hour in this setting, not fifteen minutes.
findings.rationale: The joke specifies how recently Mujin was struck, so the source quantity should be preserved.
findings.replacement: “No. I was hit about half an hour ago.”

findings.current: She was the only daughter of the Yongbong Escort Bureau, but she had not been raised like a precious flower in a hothouse.
findings.defect: An Escort Bureau cannot literally have a daughter, and 무남독녀 identifies Hwaran as the bureau chief’s sole child with no brothers. The draft also imports the hothouse image from a later sentence instead of preserving the source’s emphasis on being pampered.
findings.rationale: The source establishes both Hwaran’s family status and that she was not merely doted on despite being the sole daughter.
findings.replacement: She was the bureau chief’s only child, but that did not mean she had been raised pampered and sheltered.
findings.source: 용봉표국의 무남독녀지만 금이야 옥이야 자란 것만은 아니다.

findings.current: That was why she had not wanted to suspect them even more. She did not want to doubt them.
findings.defect: “Suspect them even more” incorrectly suggests that her degree of suspicion would increase; 더더욱 instead intensifies her unwillingness to suspect them.
findings.rationale: The source repeats and intensifies Hwaran’s reluctance to distrust the people who supported her.
findings.replacement: That made her all the more unwilling to suspect them. She did not want to doubt them.
findings.source: 그래서 더더욱 그런 이들을 의심하고 싶지 않았다. 의심하기 싫었다.

findings.current: Ju Hwaran gripped her sword hilt in a calm voice.
findings.defect: The English attaches “in a calm voice” to the physical act of gripping rather than to Hwaran’s preceding speech.
findings.rationale: 덤덤한 목소리 describes how she speaks, while 검파를 잡았다 is the simultaneous physical action.
findings.replacement: Ju Hwaran said calmly as she gripped her sword hilt.

findings.defect: The draft adds profanity absent from the source and unnecessarily intensifies the observer’s reaction.
findings.rationale: The Korean is a plain expression of bafflement without a curse.

findings.current: Just as Ju Hwaran was about to straighten her head, she noticed a star she had never seen before.
findings.defect: “Straighten her head” is an unnatural literal rendering of 고개를 바로 하다 in this context.
findings.rationale: Hwaran has been looking up at the night sky; the source says she is about to return her head and gaze to their normal forward position.
findings.replacement: Just as Ju Hwaran was about to face forward again, she noticed a star she had never seen before.
findings.source: 주화란이 고개를 바로 하려던 그때, 지금까지 보지 못했던 별 하나가 눈에 띄었다.

summary: The draft conflates the newly introduced Song Ilseom with the established Song Il, mistranslates his rank, and changes a stated interval. Several localized characterization and English-usage issues also require correction.
